description: Read the employer-only answer key for an organization-owned LMS course: every quiz lesson in course order with its questions, the correct choices marked, the expected value and matching notes for non-choice auto-graded questions, points, and each quiz pass rule. Omit versionId to read the current draft (each quiz resolves the way publishing would freeze it; a quiz with no publishable version reports a problem instead of a key); pass versionId to read one published version of this course. Read-only. Never share the result with learners; the worker-facing Preview still hides answer keys. Requires lms:read.

versionId.description: Published course version id. Omit for the current draft.

name: opentrain_lms_get_course_answer_key
